state.name: Legacy Save
state.background:
Origin: Academy Student
Starting archetype: Ninjutsu Student
Raised around Academy Student, they learned the habits and pressures expected of a Ninjutsu Student. Their home life was modest and sometimes unstable, making preparation, loyalty, and self-reliance learned habits rather than slogans. They have not given a fixed account of their earlier life. Their early ninjutsu student practice was uneven but persistent, emphasizing Ninjutsu. Isamu Nara, an aging weapons specialist, supplied guidance, friction, and an unfinished expectation. The turning point came when a border skirmish forced a choice between running and standing with the unit. They want to turn an uncertain beginning into earned capability and decide what place they will claim in the world. They still lack the experience and resources to turn every promising instinct into a dependable result.
state.active_canon_event: Naruto's birth and the Nine-Tails attack

Ninjutsu Student Fundamentals.description: Generated from the character's stated background and starting role.

background_world_feed:
July 11, Year -13 — The Kannabi Bridge mission
Location: Kannabi Bridge. Rin Nohara dies and Obito Uchiha is believed killed during a mission gone wrong; Kakashi inherits Obito's Sharingan, and both awaken the Mangekyō Sharingan in their grief. The player may engage with, avoid, redirect, or fundamentally alter what follows.

July 12, Year -13 — Yahiko's death and the founding of Akatsuki
Location: Amegakure. Yahiko dies at Hanzō and Danzō's hands; the survivor rescued from Kannabi Bridge — now calling himself Madara — along with Nagato and Konan, forms the organization that will become Akatsuki. The player may engage with, avoid, redirect, or fundamentally alter what follows.

November 8, Year -12 — Naruto's birth and the Nine-Tails attack
Location: Konohagakure. Naruto is born as Obito's attack breaks Kushina's seal; Minato and Kushina confront the Nine-Tails while Konoha fights for survival. The player may engage with, avoid, redirect, or fundamentally alter what follows.
